title: Draw sulfur dichloride
statement:
Draw the Lewis structure for $\ce{SCl2}$. Include lone pairs.

[_]{a}
hints: Count six from S and seven from each Cl.
Connect both Cl atoms to S.
Give each Cl three lone pairs and put the remainder on S.
solution: The total is 20 valence electrons. Two S–Cl single bonds use four; terminal Cl lone pairs use 12, leaving four electrons as two S lone pairs.
